notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the realmd login-protocol-v3 wire: logon challenge (game/platform/OS/locale tags, account), challenge reply (SRP6 inputs + crc_salt + security-flag/PIN consumption), logon proof, proof reply, realm-list request/response. MSUI's RealmClient.cs is a faithful port of all five shapes (same constants, same PIN-block skip, same stream-alignment reads) backed by Srp6Client.cs.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: MSUI hardcodes the Windows OS tag, which Benilla only varies for macOS hosts - correct for this Windows-only client.
